typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	EmailRecipients as string (),
	EmailSubject as string (),
	ExportFileName as string (),
	ExportFolder as string (),
	ExportFolderFile as string (),
	FailureEmailNotification as string (),
	ProcessName as string (),
	StartDate as string (),
	TemplateFile as string ()
}

source(output(
		Member_First_Name as string,
		Member_Middle_Initial as string,
		Member_Last_Name as string,
		Member_Id as string,
		Member_Medicaid_Id as string,
		Member_DOB as string,
		Tax_ID as string,
		Health_Center as string,
		Member_Gender as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT   [Member_First_Name] 		,[Member_Middle_Initial]  		,[Member_Last_Name]  		,[Member_Id]  		,[Member_Medicaid_Id]  		,[Member_DOB]  		,[Tax_ID]  		,[Health_Center]  		,[Member_Gender] FROM EXTRACT.DCPCA_MEMBER_EXTRACT',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> EXTRACTDATA
EXTRACTDATA derive({Copy of Member_Gender} = Member_Gender,
		{Copy of Member_Middle_Initial} = Member_Middle_Initial,
		{Copy of Member_DOB} = Member_DOB,
		{Copy of Member_First_Name} = Member_First_Name,
		{Copy of Member_Medicaid_Id} = Member_Medicaid_Id,
		{Copy of Member_Id} = Member_Id,
		{Copy of Member_Last_Name} = Member_Last_Name,
		{Copy of Health_Center} = Health_Center,
		{Copy of Tax_ID} = Tax_ID) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		{Copy of Member_First_Name} as string,
		{Copy of Member_Id} as string,
		{Copy of Member_Middle_Initial} as string,
		{Copy of Member_Last_Name} as string,
		{Copy of Member_DOB} as string,
		{Copy of Member_Medicaid_Id} as string,
		{Copy of Tax_ID} as string,
		{Copy of Member_Gender} as string,
		{Copy of Health_Center} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ExcelDestination
